name: Beach Walk Side Profile
tips: Walk parallel to the shoreline; catch a natural mid-stride
Chin level; gaze toward the horizon, not the lens
Let arms swing opposite the stepping foot; keep shoulders soft
Barefoot or sandals low in frame so the sand line reads cleanly
camera_cues: true side profile; full body preferred with shoreline leading lines
eye level or slight low angle; leave negative space ahead of the stride
golden hour backlight or 45° rim; 1/250s+ shutter to freeze the step
